title: Regularization Amplifies Subliminal Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.10397v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work has shown that hidden biases can be transferred through data with no apparent semantic relationship to those biases. Can regularization limit this covert influence? By constraining adaptation, regularization might be expected to suppress behavioral changes on seemingly unrelated inputs. We systematically study this hypothesis in subliminal learning, as well as in related settings of covert influence, including phantom transfer and logit-linear selection. We find the opposite: regularization amplifies the transfer of hidden biases. In particular, subliminal learning is typically absent under full fine-tuning, but low-rank adaptation or explicit penalties can induce strong transfer. Phantom transfer and logit-linear selection show similar trends. Adding more data, an implicit form of regularization, also strengthens covert influence. translated_title: 正则化放大潜意识学习
translated_abstract: 近期的研究表明，隐藏的偏见可以通过与这些偏见没有明显语义关系的数据进行传递。正则化能否限制这种隐蔽的影响？通过约束模型的适应过程，人们可能预期正则化会抑制模型在看似无关输入上的行为变化。我们在潜意识学习以及相关的隐蔽影响场景（包括幻影传递和logit线性选择）中系统地检验了这一假设。结果却发现了相反的情况：正则化会放大隐藏偏见的传递。特别地，在全量微调下通常观察不到潜意识学习，但低秩适应或显式惩罚却可以诱导出强烈的传递。幻影传递和logit线性选择也呈现出类似的趋势。增加数据量作为一种隐式正则化形式，同样会加强这种隐蔽影响。总之，这些发现表明，正则化所诱导的简单性偏见可能会促进这种隐蔽影响（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文发现正则化非但不能抑制反而会放大隐蔽影响——全量微调下通常不存在的潜意识学习，在低秩适应、显式惩罚或增加数据等正则化手段下反而会被显著诱发和增强。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that regularization, contrary to expectations, amplifies rather than suppresses covert influence—subliminal learning, typically absent under full fine-tuning, emerges strongly under low-rank adaptation, explicit penalties, or more data.
